verdict.rationale: The docs say native integrations exist: a tool may have "no integration and no MCP server" [lindy-docs-15], MCP lets Lindy act "without waiting for a native integration" [lindy-docs-1], and GitHub, Salesforce, Gmail, Slack, email and calendar are named as connected apps [lindy-docs-16][lindy-docs-12]. Nothing shows a catalog anywhere near thousands of apps. The fallbacks (pointing Lindy at MCP servers, browser driving, writing its own API integrations) are not vendor-maintained connectors. Missing for 10: evidence of a catalog of thousands of prebuilt integrations, documentation that integrations are vendor-maintained, an integration directory or listing, and independent corroboration.
